title: Fantasea Campe Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Fantasea Campe is a beautiful 3 bedroom cottage 3rd up from the beach on Pensacola Street in Seaside, Florida! This beautifully decorated cottage offers wrap around porches, 2 bedrooms on the main level with extra sleeping
description_expanded: Home Highlights: -3 Houses to the Private Seaside beach walkover at Pensacola Pavilion -Up to 8 Wrist Bands TOTAL for private beach access (per Seaside guidelines they will not provide us with more bands than the home sleeps) - Private driveway plus 2 additional parking passes - Spacious screened in patio and nice size tower - Fully stocked kitchen -Two beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. 450 thread count sheets for each bed and oversized towels in each bathroom are provided. Home Details: A spacious eat-in kitchen with dining for 6 and bar seating for 3 more is located on the main level, along with a beautifully decorated living room with vaulted ceiling, flat screen TV, and seating for the whole family! Also on the main level are the 2 guest rooms. Identical in size, but unique in décor, each guestroom offers a designer queen bed with TV and private bathrooms. One bathroom is shower only, the other has a bath/shower combo. Also, just off each guestroom is a private bunk room nook with single bunk beds that sleep 2 each with additional flat screen TVs. The upstairs boasts a sprawling master retreat with private balcony and master bath. The master bath offers dual sinks and designer tile shower. Up once more and you'll see what all the talk in Seaside is about with your private tower view! The gulf and town are at your fingertips. Watch the sun rise or set from your very own rooftop tower! Sleeping arrangements: (sleeps 8) 1st floor- Bedroom 1: Queen + bunk (sleeps 2 additional) / private bathroom (shower only), TV Bedroom 2: Queen + bunk (sleeps 2 additional) / private bathroom (bath/shower combo), TV 2nd floor- Bedroom 3: King master / private bathroom (shower only) , TV 3rd floor- Best view in the home- covered outdoor tower with plenty of seating One of our top cottages with repeat guests, Fantasea Campe is a beautiful 3-bedroom cottage 3rd up from the beach on Pensacola Street in Seaside, Florida! This beautifully decorated cottage offers wrap around porches, 2 bedrooms on the main level with extra sleeping space, and a private tower! You'll certainly feel like you're at a "Fantasea Campe" when you stay here. Surrounded by sprawling screened porches and back decks, this cottage offers as much outside living as it does inside - and you wouldn't want it any other way when you come to Seaside, Florida. Come for a week or stay for the month - no matter how long you visit, you're sure to have the time of your life when you stay at the Fantasea Campe! Fantasea Campe is located on the west side of town, close to West side pool and the 3rd cottage up from the beach. * Parking for 2 cars * Sorry, no pets allowed *Please note we automatically include the cost of swim and fitness passes to our Seaside reservations. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals and listed as part of the “HOST FEES” in VRBO’s cost breakdown. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please email us if you would like to remove this charge after booking. *Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. *Seaside amenities: Playground, Pickleball Courts, Tennis Courts, Croquet Lawn, Basketball, 3 community pools including a covered pool, Adult only pool and Family pool, Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
